story.title: MOTTU LEARNS SHAPES!
paragraphs_en: One day Chottu and Mottu were playing with their friends. "Mottu,see how many shapes are around us!" "Shapes?",wondered Mottu.
"Shape is nothing but the form or appearance of an object or its outer surface. Each object has a shape.I will help you to understand it better",said Chottu.

"Shapes can be two dimensional(2-D) or three dimensional(3-D). Two dimensional shapes are flat plane shapes that have length and breadth only.A square,rectangle,triangle,circle,oval are all examples of a 2-D shape.The amount of space occupied by a 2-D object is known as its area",said Chottu.
"3-D shapes have length,breadth and height.They have thickness.A cone,sphere,cylinder,cube,pyramid are all 3-D shapes.The area occupied by a 3-D object is known as its volume"explained Chottu.
"Mottu ,do you know the shape of this board?",asked Chottu. "I don't know",said Mottu. "This board is SQUARE in shape.It has four equal sides.All the angles in a square is a right angle(90 degree)."
"Mottu,can you guess the shape of this roof?",asked Chottu. "I have no idea",said Mottu. "It is TRIANGLE in shape and it has three sides.All the sides may or may not be equal in size".

﻿ 'Mottu,do you know the shape of this dice,the block on which I am seated and the piece of ice on your head?" "Square",said Mottu freezing in cold. "It is a CUBE and has six equal faces.Each face has four equal sides.A square is 2-D whereas a cube is 3-D.You can consider it as the combination of six squares ".

"Mottu,can you tell me the shape of the wrapper in which the ice cream is wrapped?" "Triangle"said Mottu. "It is CONE in shape.It looks similar to a triangle but it 3-D whereas a triangle is 2-D.It has a flat base in the shape of a circle and the body has curved sides leading to a narrow point." " By the way,what is a circle?,asked Mottu.
" See,the shape of the mat on which we sleep everyday.It is CIRCLE in shape.It has no sides.",said Chottu.

"Mottu,Can you tell me the shape of this slice of bread?" . "It looks like a square",said Mottu. "This slice of bread,the window,the photo frame are all RECTANGLE in shape.It has four sides like a square but all the four sides are not equal. The opposite sides are equal.It has length(how long it is) and breadth(how wide it is)".
" Mottu,Can you tell me the shape of this log?" "It looks like a circle at the top"was the reply. "It is CYLINDER in shape .It is round and has top and bottom in the shape of a circle".

" Mottu,Do you know the shape of the mirror in which you look at your face while brushing your teeth?". "It looks like a circle squeezed from both the sides". "It is OVAL in shape.It is a closed curve and looks like an egg".

"Mottu,tell me the shape of this kite". "It looks like a slanting square"replied Mottu. "It is a RHOMBUS .It has four equal sides like a square.But the angles in a rhombus are not right angles.The opposite sides are parallel(do not intersect at any point).It looks like a diamond".

"Mottu,do you know the shape in which this moon looks like?" Mottu tilted his head saying 'No'. It is CRESENT .It is thin,curved shape that is thicker in the middle and thin at the ends like that of a growing moon".

"Mottu,do you know the shape of the samosas?". "Cone shaped?",asked Mottu. "It is PYRAMID in shape.It has three or more triangular faces whereas a cone has curved sides.The base of a pyramid may be square or triangle in shape".
Mottu looked at the honey comb and wondered what shape it was. "It is a HEXAGON .It has six equal sides.It has six angles each with 120 degrees",said Chottu.

"Mottu,look at the shape of the globe.Can you tell me the shape of it?". "It looks like a circle." "It is a SPHERE . Both circle and sphere are circular objects.But circle is two dimensional whereas a sphere is three dimensional."
"Mottu,now you have learnt most of the shapes.Tell me the shapes you see around you",said Chottu. Dear children,let us help Mottu in finding out the two dimensional shapes.
Please help Mottu in finding out the three dimensional shapes.
